public class MMLTHypothesis<I,O> extends CompactMMLT<I,O>
The hypothesis model is a regular MMLT that includes an additional prefix mapping. This mapping assigns a short prefix to each location.

  • Method Details

    • getPrefix

      public Word<TimedInput<I>> getPrefix(State<Integer,O> configuration)
      Returns the prefix assigned to the provided configuration. The assigned prefix is the concatenation of the prefix assigned to the active location and the minimal number of time steps needed to reach the configuration after entering its location (= entry distance).
      Parameters:
      configuration - the considered configuration
      Returns:
      the assigned prefix

    • getPrefix

      public Word<TimedInput<I>> getPrefix(Integer location)
      Returns a prefix for the given location. This prefix is deterministic in the learner.
      Parameters:
      location - the location
      Returns:
      the location prefix

    • getPrefix

      public Word<TimedInput<I>> getPrefix(Word<TimedInput<I>> prefix)
      Returns a prefix for the location reached by the given prefix. This prefix is deterministic in the learner.
      Parameters:
      prefix - the access sequence to the location
      Returns:
      the (canonical) location prefix
